messages.author: 6202ea74940a9a19
messages.subject: Problem importing SilicoDArt data
parts:
Hello,

I have been trying to import presence/absence data from SilicoDArT and convert to genind format using the function gl.read.silicodart, but I keep having the following error:

> glsilico <- gl.read.silicodart(datafile = "data/SilicoDArT_Wheat.csv", topskip=6, nmetavar=18, nas="-", ind.metafile = "data/metada.csv")

Error in make.unique(x$CloneID, sep = "_") : 'names' must be a character vector

I appreciate any help.

Best regards,

Oscar

I'm using the dartR version 1.1.11 and had the same problem that Orscar was reporting some days ago when trying to read a SIlicoDarT csv report:
